paragraphs: R' Gamliel the son of R' Ilai: Shevuot, end of chapter 5; Yohanan the son of Rabbi Ilai: [Sukkah 27b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.27b.10).[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara names Yochanan beRabbi Ilai as the owner of the sukkah in Rabbi Eliezer’s story. Hyman’s separate Gamliel reference remains at the end of Shevuot chapter 5. The notices do not establish that the two men had the same father.
